## Summary

Describe the manuscript source, rendering, or documentation change.

## Traceability

- [ ] Title is `#<issue> <type>(optional-scope): summary` and matches the branch.
- [ ] `Refs: #<issue>` or `Closes: #<issue>` is included below.

## Verification

- [ ] English PDF built twice with `pdflatex`.
- [ ] Chinese PDF built twice with `xelatex`.
- [ ] Relevant logs contain no undefined citation/reference warning.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_public_release.py`

## Research and data integrity

- [ ] No raw or transformed data, checkpoint, row-level output, local path, credential, or archive is included.
- [ ] Any paper claim is supported by a reviewed source, validated artifact, or explicitly marked as a draft/protocol.
- [ ] English/Chinese alignment and PDF-output impact are described.
